{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.02

|gr1= GUI Control - Tree View 

|descr= Sorts all children, including trees deriving from given path.  Value of [[CT_TREE|Tree View]] entries is used for sorting.

|s1= control [[tvSortByValueAll]] [path, reversed]

|p1= control: [[Control]] 

|p2= path: [[Tree View Path]] - path to start sorting from

|p3= reversed: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to reverse sort it.

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_ctrl tvSortByValueAll [[], false]; // Sorts the complete Tree View</sqf>

|seealso= [[tvSort]] [[tvSortByValue]] [[tvSortAll]]
}}
